runtimeHashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 TSV, runtime files sorted by file.localeCompare(other, en); each line: path<TAB>byte length<TAB>lowercase SHA-256<LF>. POSIX relative paths, no BOM. See RUNTIME_SHA256.tsv.
snapshotInventoryAlgorithm: Same canonical TSV rule applied to all original candidate files
limitations: Human product acceptance does not complete physical-phone/Safari/low-end QA or authorize integration/deploy/ads.
